def match_pattern(s, t):
    if '*' not in s:
        return "YES" if s == t else "NO"
    
    parts = s.split('*')
    prefix, suffix = parts[0], parts[1]
    
    if len(prefix) + len(suffix) > len(t):
        return "NO"
    
    if t.startswith(prefix) and t.endswith(suffix):
        return "YES"
    else:
        return "NO"
